professionalSummary: Experienced Systems Project Manager with a proven track record of leading multi-property property management system implementations across 12 hotels, delivering on schedule, within budget, and with full go‑live approval and stabilisation.
Expertise in vendor coordination, data migration, cut‑over execution, staff training, and budget management.
Strong ability to plan complex projects, maintain dependency logs, and report variances to senior leadership.
experienceHighlights: Planned and executed a phased replacement of the property management system across 12 hotels in three waves, creating detailed schedules and dependency logs shared with the vendor.
Coordinated guest profile and reservation data migration, performed reconciliation checks on record counts and deposit balances, and signed off reconciliations with the vendor.
Led overnight cut‑over for each wave, achieving go‑live approval and running a two‑week stabilisation desk post‑cut‑over.
Organised front‑desk and reservations training using a training copy of the new system, aligned with shift patterns.
Managed hardware and training budget lines, reporting monthly spend variances to the IT director.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Wave‑three cut‑over plan detailing overnight timeline, reconciliation checklist, fallback decision point at 04:00, contact list for vendor and duty managers, and go/no‑go criteria for the fallback point.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample documents establish the candidate’s experience in planning, coordinating, executing, and budgeting multi‑property system implementation projects, including data migration, cut‑over, training, and post‑cut‑over stabilisation. They do not provide evidence of experience outside the described hotel group or of additional responsibilities beyond those listed.
